notes:
Topline: Verdant runs a research knowledge portal for fixed-income and equity research used by >3k analysts internally and ~700 external clients. They want to re-architect search from keyword-based ES to RAG: large-scale embeddings + reranking.

Recent engagement: discovery -> proof-of-concept. Customer insists on EU-only residency + KMS/HSM key control and audit trails. Prefers dedicated GPU pools for predictable p95 latencies and throughput.

Requirements (direct from CTO call):
- Index scale: initial 300M docs, plan to grow to 1B+ vector shards over 12 months.
- Query profile: mixed read-heavy (60%) with bursts during market opens, steady QPS target 200-500, peak bursts to 1k QPS.
- Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end <120ms for top-k retrieval+rerank (ideal 80-100ms).
- Cost target: avg cost/query < $0.003 after batching & caching.
- Models: embeddings candidates: open models (text-embedding-3-small), considering hosted fine-tuned distil models; reranker: light BERT-style cross-encoder for top-50 rerank.
- Routing: want routing by tenant and latency tier; fallback path to smaller quantized models if capacity constrained.

POC details:
- Dataset: 45M cleaned research notes + tables + PDFs (converted to chunks).
- Current baseline: ES-based BM25 median latency 250ms; recall gaps on tables/attachments.
- POC goal: replicate production ingestion pipeline, validate vector index build times, measure incremental cost per query, evaluate reranker drop-in.

Security/compliance:
- Must integrate with customer KMS (Azure Key Vault + HSM-backed keys), per-tenant envelope encryption.
- Audit logs required for all model requests, retention policy 7 years for a subset of regulatory flows.
- SSO via SAML, SCIM provisioning.

Sales notes / quotes from meetings:
- "We need predictable tail latency — no black box autoscale that spikes cost." — Head of Platform
- "Data residency is non-negotiable for regulated clients in DE/FR." — Compliance lead

Open technical questions:
- How will prefix/KV caching behave across dedicated GPU pools and per-tenant isolation?
- Detailed schematic for HSM integration + key rotation cadence.
- Realistic throughput numbers for top-k=100 rerank with a cross-encoder on dedicated A100 / H100 instances.
